description: This file is a script that generates a TypeScript module containing bundled provider authentication environment variables. It imports utility functions, processes plugin sources to extract provider environment variables, and writes the output to a generated file.

methods.name: normalizeProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Normalizes provider authentication environment variables into a sorted array of providerId and envVars pairs.

methods.name: collectBundledProviderAuthEnvVars
methods.description: Collects and consolidates provider authentication environment variables from bundled plugin sources.

methods.name: renderBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Renders a JavaScript module string representing provider env vars as a const record.

methods.name: writeBundledProviderAuthEnvVarModule
methods.description: Generates the module content and writes it to the output path.
